title: Visual hierarchy and composition
summary: Visual hierarchy and composition operational rules curated for Zanker. Independent synthesis; consult primary sources for exact normative requirements.

rules.title: One dominant focal point
rules.intent: Create a clear priority for the primary task and important data
principles: Create a clear priority for the primary task and important data
acceptance: Primary action is identified in five-second review

rules.title: Consistent visual rhythm
rules.intent: Use consistent layout rhythm and deliberate whitespace
principles: Use consistent layout rhythm and deliberate whitespace
acceptance: Spacing ties to tokens or explicit pattern

rules.title: Optical and geometric alignment
rules.intent: Inspect perceptual alignment in addition to box coordinates
principles: Inspect perceptual alignment in addition to box coordinates
antiPatterns: Mathematically centered but visually imbalanced glyphs
acceptance: Screenshot passes visual inspection at multiple sizes

rules.title: Intentional information density
rules.intent: Adapt density to frequency of use, expertise and screen size
principles: Adapt density to frequency of use, expertise and screen size
antiPatterns: Universal oversized cards for expert workflows
acceptance: Common tasks visible without excessive scrolling

rules.title: Balanced composition
rules.intent: Balance large and small shapes and contrasting regions
principles: Balance large and small shapes and contrasting regions
antiPatterns: Uniform tile repetition with no hierarchy

rules.title: Purposeful negative space
rules.intent: Use whitespace to establish grouping and legibility
principles: Use whitespace to establish grouping and legibility
